column1: # s1h.tsv -- the mutations base#1466 (config-gen S1h, the shared tool-image
# helper and config_gen_resolve) requires script/test/mutation-probe.sh to
# report PINNED. One row per behaviour:
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.
